description: A tab's right-click menu in Record.

actions.does: Puts the tab's absolute link on the clipboard, for pasting into an agent: a page of notes' file path, a chat's transcript path, a file's code path. Toast "Link copied", or "This page has no link to copy".
Same, for the tab shown; its menu name there is "Copy Link to This Page" (in ☰).

parts.name: Rename…
parts.shows: Item "Rename…", enabled only on a chat's tab.
